ns2:section.sectionText: This course will be hybrid, with some in-person instruction and some online instruction. No course fee will be applied for spring 2021. If you have any questions, please email course coordinator Betty Allen at bjallen@illinois.edu. We are working with the School of Education regarding individual student needs for completing this course. Betty will respond to all emails regarding FAA 202 in early to mid-January. All students who need this course should register when their time ticket is released. Distributed attendance will be utilized for the in-person component of the class.
